description:
Each tracked artifact in the nineteen open-epic `dev/active/` entries listed below present at commit `7641561a9` receives one manifest row with ownership evidence, code consumers and a disposition, so regrouping and archival act only on defensible ownership.

## Background

Ownership is admissible only from an existing tracker document reference, an unambiguous issue identifier in the path or content, or unique `jit:<short-id>` commit provenance; an artifact without admissible evidence is unassociated and goes to `dev/archive/legacy/<original-relative-path>`. `dev/active/fa787f85-documentation-overhaul/investigation.md` Appendix A gives the 2026-10-01 entry classification (the remaining class (a) rows) and the method used to derive it.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The manifest holds one row per tracked file in the frozen entry list below (the nineteen open-epic `dev/active/` entries listed below present at commit `7641561a9`), with owner or association evidence, owning top-level epic, bundle relationships and disposition.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every ownership claim cites an admissible evidence class; rows without admissible evidence carry the legacy-archive disposition.
- [hard] REQ-03: Entries shared by several epics record every owner and the destination chosen by the multi-owner rule.
- [hard] REQ-04: Each entry whose path a non-comment consumer reads or checks (production code, tests, scripts, measurement tooling, relative Cargo paths or configuration) is marked code-pinned and records every such consumer by file and line, and each digest-pinned machine input in the entry is marked.
- [hard] REQ-05: The progress checker reports the shard's rows schema-valid with every source assertion passing.

## Notes

Frozen entry list: `02b8137c`, `0b0714e0`, `0de41c82`, `150d7d79`, `3d522ba0`, `3f664839`, `41c3d91d`, `4e732b56`, `591a1c5e`, `64fd3afd`, `8b3fe657`, `aabc528a`, `ae03bcd0-general-bch`, `aed96ef9-finite-blocklength-bounds`, `b4b4b9ee-tech-debt-2026-06-30`, `b8206228-permanent-statistics`, `d1b4f85e`, `fa787f85-documentation-overhaul`, `fd9d5416`. `0b0714e0` belongs to epic cffc15dd and `fd9d5416` to epic ae03bcd0; both postdate the investigation survey and predate the freeze. Entries created after commit `7641561a9` are outside this migration; the `@/inv/active-document-layout` invariant governs them at creation. The code-consumer scan (`dev/active/fa787f85-documentation-overhaul/dev-path-code-consumers.md`) already identifies these entries as code-pinned: 02b8137c, 3f664839, d1b4f85e, 591a1c5e and fd9d5416.
